wielksoc statstyyki testowehj, p value i czy przyjmuje czu orzuaca
```{r}
k <- c(20,60,40)
m <- c(45,15,20)

m <- matrix(c(k,m), nrow=3,ncol=2,
            dimnames = list(c('wole A', 'wole B','nie widze różnicy'),
                            c('kobiety','mezczyzni')))
m

chi <- chisq.test(m, correct = F)
chi$residuals

chi$p.value
chi
```

rozwaizanie wykladwoacy
```{r}
#dane <- read.csv('vacation.csv')
dane <- vacation

x <- cbind(1, dane$income, dane$age, dane$kids)
y <- dane$miles
beta_hat <- solve(t(x)%*% x) %*% t(x) %*% y

model <-  lm(miles~income+age+kids, data=dane)
model$coefficients
summary(model)

resid <- x%*%beta_hat-y
var(resid)*(nrow(dane)-1)/(nrow(dane)-4)

sqrt(var(resid)*(nrow(dane)-1)/nrow())
```
